title: ProJPG
description: Enhance cartoon/animated image quality and resolution using a UNet ML model.
Trained on a 42GB image dataset to increase image resolution by over 100% while reducing pixelation and blur effects.

title: Animewreck
description: Recommendation engine that suggests tailor-made anime shows based on a user's past watch history.
Visualise and explore the embedding space to find similar shows, represented as a 3D force graph.

title: Urban Data Visualization
description: Visualise Bangalore on a map with insights on parks, public transportation, public toilets, and criminal cases.
Awarded 1st place at a 24-hour hackathon with a team of 5 members.

title: T-Vecs
description: Learns a linear transformation between multidimensional word vector spaces of English and Hindi without using parallel corpora.
Generates semantically similar words across languages using Word2Vec embeddings.
